profile.sourceInventory: Explicit source superset, not every pinned file executed.

boundaries.source: Actual queued-input World histories; all diagnostic private fields stay separate from actual human/bot method inputs.
boundaries.human: Exact source callback extraction is labelled separately from unrun full Phaser scene/Minimap/rendering. No display proof.
boundaries.policy: Consumer method outputs are not submitted actions or full-Brain outcomes.
boundaries.privacy: No automatic ID-only equivalence, hidden lifetime knowledge, intended-death rule, native/public-fact/P15 design or universal cap is admitted.

declaredSetup.classification: declared arena geometry and starting seats; all actors and observed positions are source-produced

worldRandom.scope: opts.random only; createGameWorld separates fixed rewardSalt/questSalt streams

lifecycleGaps.hiddenDeathAndReplacement: not attempted in this bounded witness; this proves living out-of-sight return only
lifecycleGaps.observerMemorySemantics: parent consumer derives its own result from every actual step; this source producer does not infer death from absence
lifecycleGaps.observedOutputProvenance: all lifecycle positions/statuses above are sampled from the live World after step; no fixture snapshot is installed

humanProvenance.sourceMode: exact AST source-span extraction; source methods/callback bodies are transpiled from unchanged RaidScene.ts spans and invoked

callbackInvocation.roomSessionIdentity: viewerId supplied as the exact sessionId field consumed by the extracted callback; no Room/socket implementation

executionLimits.actorScope: prefix-admitted regional kinds mob/elite; quest returns from the extracted prefix; other kinds may be reported as prefix rows but no downstream view behavior is claimed
executionLimits.frameClock: serverTime reused as local receipt time (zero-jitter declared clock); EntityInterpolator's production default clock is used
executionLimits.visionOrigin: authoritative viewer row from decoded state; no local prediction path is run
executionLimits.geometry: the supplied source map, or actual shared withGates(map) when state.gatesLocked
executionLimits.claimBoundary: actual callback inputs/admission rows only; not display pixels, full RaidScene, MobView, or Minimap painting

botProvenance.classification: actual source perceive -> FrameRing -> Memory -> HuntAdapter/MobHunter method witness over decoded earned World updates
botProvenance.scope: no full Brain, strategy/tactics scheduling, humanizer, action submission or survival proof; returned decisions never feed the World
botProvenance.visibility: actual sim/vision.canPlayerSee(sourceWorld, viewerId, point); no substituted visibility callback or manually installed vision history
botProvenance.publication: parent owns actual FxChannel batch-before-patch/extendRoster/Schema encode-decode/rosterSent; this consumer receives that exact optional fourth argument and never changes roster or World
botProvenance.order: preserve actual source lists, Map insertion order and IDs; no sort, canonical rename or synthetic memory entries

configuration.invocationCadence: Memory and HuntAdapter run once per composed push; this does not claim the full Brain's configured decision cadence
configuration.engagedMeaning: no tactics module is run; default HuntAdapter attacking fallback sees this explicit method-probe value
configuration.learned: disabled; no learned store or external bias

methodRng.boundary: separate declared method seeds, not full Brain derive/reset wiring; Knowledge creation draws and any method draws are observed in order; World RNG is untouched

botProvenance.consumerDiagnostics: engagement and ban Map are read-only snapshots of actual TypeScript private consumer fields, separate from policy inputs; no expiry-mutating accessor is called just to observe bans

derivedCoverage.classification: derived only from captured source returns; never an input to World or consumers
derivedCoverage.counterexampleBoundary: If the flag is true, it is a producer-consistent counterexample to treating minimap omission as authoritative death. It is not a source-bug or intended-behavior classification, hidden-death/replacement equivalence, or private-ID publication approval.
